title: staging try_stage uses BEGIN IMMEDIATE for atomic capacity check and INSERT
description:
## Decision
crates/transit/src/staging.rs try_stage() correctly uses sqlx::query('BEGIN IMMEDIATE') before the capacity check + INSERT, preventing a race where two concurrent stage operations both pass the capacity limit check. This is the correct pattern for SQLite capacity enforcement. (Contrast: drain_one() uses the wrong pool.begin() — filed as stoa-e2297bae.1.)
